paragraphs.text: LAMID ONE keeps intent, accountability, and consequential control with people while continuous intelligence and already-authorized work can progress over time within defined boundaries.
Use only information, connected sources, and progression scopes permitted for the task, workspace, or organization. No permission expands itself.
Review, edit, disable, or delete remembered context; control eligible progression permissions; and revoke them where available.

sections.label: Progression Does Not Equal Unlimited Authority
sections.title: Progression Does Not Equal Unlimited Authority

paragraphs.text: Progression Does Not Equal Unlimited Authority
• Observe & Update - permitted context ingestion, synchronization, recalculation, status refresh, pattern detection, and analysis.
• Progress Within Authorization - already-approved workflow steps, scheduled processing, defined notifications, and explicitly delegated work within scope.

• Consequential Commitment - financial, legal, strategic, external, permission-changing, reputational, or irreversible actions pause for human approval unless that exact authority was explicitly delegated in advance under policy.
A lower authority band never silently becomes a higher one.

sections.label: More Capable AI Requires More Deliberate Governance.
sections.title: More Capable AI Requires More Deliberate Governance.

paragraphs.text: More Capable AI Requires More Deliberate Governance.
Increase evaluation, freshness checks, explanation, permission controls, override paths, auditability, and human review as persistent progression influences more consequential work.
